summary: Woodside Energy Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing its ASX announcement and Capital Markets Day 2026 presentation dated November 5, 2026. The materials outline strategy, not a transaction: a new distribution policy of 20-40% of adjusted operating cash flow (20% base dividend, up to 20% more via dividends/buybacks), a capital framework requiring growth to compete against distributions, a target 12-15% portfolio ROACE by the mid-2030s, US$400M annual structural cost reductions from 2028, and Scarborough 99% complete. No stake, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is stated; risk-arb angles are absent.
